tasks.title: Vendored client gates: roadmap-gate.yml
tasks.objective: Every client with an authored roadmap gets the same CI teeth the harness has: a PR cannot land work without declaring its completed story or window, and the default branch cannot silently carry audit gaps. Unprepared clients and the harness itself stay green via the arming rule (decision 0036).
acceptance_criteria: New vendored .github/workflows/roadmap-gate.yml: on pull_request + bare push; both jobs run checkout (PR job fetch-depth 0), setup-python 3.11, and one arming step writing armed=true to GITHUB_OUTPUT iff constitution/VENDORED_FROM exists AND plans/roadmap.json parses with >=1 epic (malformed roadmap fails the step loudly); gate steps guarded on steps.arm.outputs.armed.

PR job mirrors pr-ticket-check.yml's three-env invocation of check_pr_ticket.py (BASE_SHA/HEAD_BRANCH/PR_BODY) with NO pytest self-test step; push job guarded if github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch runs python3 factory/scripts/forge.py project audit (full severity, decision 0036).
check_pr_ticket.py: a base ref with no plans/roadmap.json resolves to {} at the git-show call site (shared git() raiser untouched); branch_ticket accepts feature/{key}- alongside feat/{key}-.

scaffold.py COPY_WORKFLOWS gains the one entry; test_scaffold_delivers_factory_workflows asserts the new file; WORKFLOW.md gates section rewritten to name .github/workflows/roadmap-gate.yml as the vendored contract while the harness's internal implementations stay internal, plus the arming sentence in the Project Roadmap section; test_vendored_docs_do_not_reference_unvendored_workflows stays green.

forge defer add records the default-branch retrofit for factory-scaffold.yml/harness-health.yml push legs with the trigger from the plan; new tests: workflow-shape (both jobs, arming conditions, default-branch guard, three env vars, no pytest step), base-absent-roadmap PR passes, feature/KEY branch infers the ticket.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "pr_ticket or gate_a or scaffold_delivers or roadmap_gate"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The arming step must fail loudly on malformed roadmap.json, not fall through to disarmed; the VENDORED_FROM condition cannot be dropped from either job; the git-show fallback lives at the call site only so other git() callers keep raising; the workflow has no step a client repo cannot run (no factory/tests, no gh api); WORKFLOW.md references only vendored paths (0034).
